title: viewer.config.json
description: Configuration file for System2 Viewer. Controls indexing behavior, subsystem definitions, architectural rules, and remote settings.

$schema.description: Path or URL to the JSON Schema for this configuration file.

repository.description: Repository-level metadata and file exclusion patterns.

name.description: Human-readable repository name. Used in claim IDs and display output.

exclude.description: Glob patterns for files and directories to exclude from indexing.

indexing.description: Controls how the indexer processes source files, git history, and symbols.

gitHistoryDepth.description: Maximum number of git commits to mine for co-change data. Set to 0 to skip git history analysis.

symbolBackend.description: Symbol extraction backend. 'treesitter' is the default and requires no external tooling.

sqlite.description: SQLite PRAGMA tuning for the local store database.

pageSize.description: SQLite page size in bytes. Must be a power of 2.

cacheSize.description: SQLite cache size. Negative values specify KB; positive values specify pages.

mmapSize.description: SQLite memory-mapped I/O size in bytes. 0 disables mmap.

workerCount.description: Number of parallel worker threads for symbol extraction. Defaults to CPU count.

workerMinFiles.description: Minimum file count before the indexer spawns worker threads.

subsystems.description: Manually defined subsystem boundaries. Overrides inferred subsystems for the given IDs.

paths.description: Glob patterns for files belonging to this subsystem.

rules.description: Architectural dependency rules enforced during check-invariants.

name.description: Rule name, used in violation reports.

claimTypes.description: Custom claim type definitions with optional verification recipes.

id.description: Unique claim type identifier. Must not collide with built-in types.

displayTemplate.description: Template string for human-readable claim display.

defaultVerificationRecipes.description: Recipes the VerificationEngine runs to check claims of this type.

recipeType.description: Recipe type: source_span_check, symbol_exists_check, import_edge_check, or grep_check.

description.description: Human-readable description of what this recipe verifies.

command.description: Optional shell command for custom recipe execution.

evidenceRequirements.description: Evidence types required to support claims of this type.

severity.description: Default severity for claims of this type.

remote.description: Remote synchronization settings. Currently only enables/disables the feature.
